name: Cellcom (Wisconsin)
notes: Researched from public cellcom.com support FAQs, plan pages, contact page, the myCellcom sign-in page and the Quik|Pay page (rendered with a headless browser; nothing submitted). Postpaid; Cellcom bills monthly access a month ahead, so plan changes prorate. myCellcom sign-in uses a User ID (username) and password created at registration; forgotten passwords get a temporary password. Quik|Pay pays without signing in using the mobile number or account number plus the account ZIP code (guestLookupFields [phone, zip], guestLookupExact). Online one-time payments by credit card or checking/savings account; recurring payments (autopay) by debit/credit card or checking/savings. The $10 per line Unlimited discount needs autopay from a checking or savings account plus paperless bill with a confirmed email; card autopay does not qualify. Paperless bill is supported. Customer Care: 611, 800-236-0055 (also catalog pay-by-phone). Canceling service is handled by phone, chat or store (account closing described for deceased customers); no online cancel documented (cancel_service unsupported, inferred). Late fees appear on the bill when applicable but the amount is not published. Plan prices are the published one-line prices, which already include the $10 autopay and paperless discount.

guest_pay.note: Quik|Pay needs your mobile number or account number and the account ZIP code.

autopay.note: Autopay can use a debit or credit card or a checking or savings account, but only checking or savings plus Paperless Bill earns the discounted Unlimited rate.

paperless.note: Sign up under myBill; confirm your email address to finish enrolling.

cancel_service.note: To cancel Cellcom service, call Customer Care at 800-236-0055 (611 from your Cellcom phone), use chat, or visit a Cellcom store.

pay_by_phone.note: Call Customer Care at 800-236-0055 or dial 611 from your Cellcom phone.

change_plan.note: No fee or contract extension to change plans; because Cellcom bills a month ahead, your next bill shows a proration.

notes: Late fees appear on the bill when applicable; the amount is not published on the support pages.
A Network and Administrative Support Fee of $5.77 per line (as of April 1, 2026) and other recovery fees and surcharges appear on the bill.
Activating or upgrading a device costs $35; lines on a service agreement can owe an early termination fee.

help.title: Autopay and paperless bill
paragraphs: Sign up for autopay and paperless bill under myBill on the myCellcom web portal, under Settings in the myCellcom app, by calling 611, or in a Cellcom store. To get the discounted Unlimited rates ($10 off per line each month) you need both autopay from a checking or savings account and paperless bill with your email confirmed. Credit and debit card autopay works but does not earn the discount.

You need both autopay from a checking or savings account and paperless bill (with your email confirmed) to get the discounted Unlimited rates of $10 per line. Credit and debit card autopay works but does not earn the discount.

help.title: Making a payment in myCellcom
paragraphs: Choose Make a Payment, then pay with a credit card or a checking or savings account. The full balance is preselected; you can pay just the past-due amount or another amount. A confirmation screen appears when the payment posts.
Quik|Pay lets anyone pay with the mobile or account number and the account ZIP code without logging in. All authorized users on an account can make a payment.

help.title: Cellcom Unlimited Plus plans
paragraphs: One-line monthly prices with the $10 autopay and paperless discount: Unlimited Plus Starter $57.49, Unlimited Plus Standard $72.49 and Unlimited Plus Select $82.49; per-line prices drop as you add lines. A 2-year service agreement adds $20 a month.

extra.intent: Using Cellcom's support pages, find which autopay payment types qualify for the discounted Unlimited rates. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Only checking or savings accounts (together with paperless bill) qualify.

extra.intent: Find what Cellcom Quik|Pay asks for besides a mobile or account number. Do not make a payment.
